tasks.q: What is the first step in a capacity calculation?
a: Work out the size of one file
Count the pixels on the screen
tasks.fb: Then multiply by the number of files and convert units.

tasks.q: A card holds 64 GB and each photo is 4 MB. Roughly how many photos fit?
What is the formula for the size of a bitmap image?
tasks.fb: All in pixels and bits per pixel.

tasks.q: A 500 × 400 image has a colour depth of 4 bits. What is its size in bits?
What is the formula for the size of a sound file?
tasks.fb: Multiply by the number of channels for stereo.

tasks.q: A 10-second clip is recorded at 8,000 Hz with a bit depth of 8. What is its size in bits?
A 500-character text file uses 8 bits per character. How large is it?
Why is the same text larger in Unicode than in ASCII?
a: Unicode uses more bits per character
tasks.fb: More bits per character means a bigger file.

tasks.q: 300 photos are 3 MB each. Will they fit on a 1 GB memory stick?
a: No: they need 900 MB, which fits, but only just
tasks.fb: 300 × 3 MB = 900 MB, which is under 1,000 MB.

tasks.q: Why should you show your working?
a: Marks are given for the method, even if the final number is wrong
tasks.fb: Write the formula, substitute the numbers, then convert.

tasks.q: Why is a real photo file usually smaller than the calculated raw size?
tasks.fb: Compression is covered in lessons 15 and 16.

tasks.q: Which would double a bitmap image's file size?
tasks.fb: Doubling either the number of pixels or the bits per pixel doubles the size.

tasks.q: An image is 800 × 600 with a colour depth of 8 bits. What is the file size in bytes?
A 60-second clip is sampled at 20,000 Hz with a bit depth of 16. What is the file size in bits?
A text file has 4,000 characters stored in 16-bit Unicode. How big is it in bytes?

info.title: CD quality
info.text: A music CD samples at 44,100 Hz with 16-bit depth in stereo, which is about 10 MB per minute of audio.

info.title: Why 44,100?
info.text: Sampling must be at least twice the highest frequency you want to record. Human hearing stops around 20 kHz, so 44.1 kHz covers it.

info.title: Raw photos
info.text: Professional cameras can save 'raw' files with 14 bits per colour channel, which is why they're often 30 MB or more each.

info.title: Metadata adds up
info.text: A photo's metadata includes the date, camera settings and often GPS coordinates, which is worth remembering in exam answers.

info.title: Streaming
info.text: An hour of standard-definition streaming uses roughly 1 GB; 4K uses about 7 GB, which is why data limits matter.

info.title: Show your working
info.text: Examiners award method marks. Even if you slip up dividing by 8, the formula and substitution can still earn marks.
